literature.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 快速抗原检测试验在2例(2.5%)中检测到SARS-CoV-2,而RSV和流感A、B型病毒均未被检测到。相比之下,RT-qPCR在4份样本(4.9%)中检测到RSV。 [10.5897/ajmr2026.9867]
遗传缺失或药理学抑制ADAM17减少了RSV诱导的合胞体形成、病毒入胞后传播和病毒滴度。 [10.1128/jvi.01150-26]
单克隆抗体,特别是尼塞韦单抗(尼塞韦单抗),已被证明可显著降低下呼吸道感染、住院、重症监护病房入院以及严重RSV相关疾病的发病率,且具有良好的安全性。 [10.24875/bmhime.m26000139]

有合并症的老年人中和抗体滴度水平低于年轻健康成年人,我们发现结合IgG与中和抗体滴度之间存在正相关关系。有慢性肝病的老年人中和活性显著低于年轻健康成年人(p = 0·009),有恶性肿瘤的老年人中和活性也显著降低(p = 0·04)。RSV特异性T细胞反应在老年人中显著低于健康年轻成年人,其IFN-γ ELISpot值的中位数分别为每百万细胞8个和68个斑点形成单位(SFU)(p = 0·0068)。 [10.1186/s12979-026-00603-6]
本研究确定了一条由细胞外ISG15启动、通过整合素-FAK信号介导的替代非经典ISGylation途径,与经典的IFN驱动的ISGylation不同。此外,还表明细胞外ISG15在缺乏ISG15转录上调的情况下增强了基础细胞内ISG15蛋白的翻译后稳定性,以支持ISGylation。 [10.1186/s12964-026-03247-7]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Rapid antigen tests detected SARS-CoV-2 in 2 cases (2.5%), whereas RSV and influenza A and B were not detected. In contrast, RT-qPCR identified RSV in 4 samples (4.9%). [10.5897/ajmr2026.9867]
Genetic loss or pharmacological inhibition of ADAM17 reduced RSV-induced formation of syncytia, post-entry viral spread, and viral titers. [10.1128/jvi.01150-26]

Monoclonal antibodies, particularly nirsevimab, have demonstrated significant reductions in lower respiratory tract infection, hospitalization, intensive care unit admission, and severe RSV-associated disease, with a favorable safety profile. [10.24875/bmhime.m26000139]

The magnitude of neutralizing antibody titers was lower in older adults with comorbidities compared to young healthy adults and we found a positive correlation between binding IgG and neutralizing antibody titers. [10.1186/s12979-026-00603-6]

The study identified an alternative non-canonical ISGylation route initiated by extracellular ISG15 and mediated by integrin-FAK signaling, in contrast to the classical IFN-driven ISGylation. [10.1186/s12964-026-03247-7]

news.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 该报告讨论了呼吸道病毒活动水平,包括呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV),但未确认、怀疑或报告任何特定的事件。它是一份关于公共卫生趋势的一般性更新。 [news-cfa885893a834f08]
国家传染病研究所(NICD)报告称,2026年呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)季已结束。 [news-ff7f507fa0d2a4ff]
报告称加拿大老年人群中RSV 疫苗接种率较低,仅75岁及以上老年人的34%和60-74岁有慢性病的老年人的21%接种了疫苗。国家免疫咨询委员会(NACI)建议对这些群体接种疫苗接种,但各省对疫苗的资金支持不一。 [news-c2ffe2771d68424e]
美国肺脏协会发起了一项活动,旨在教育患有肺部疾病及其他风险因素的人群,接种年度呼吸道病毒疫苗的重要性,以预防严重疾病、并发症和住院。这是一项推荐的预防措施,而非确认的暴发。 [news-349823f12bde8625]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Respiratory syncytial virus news developments.
key_findings_en: The report discusses respiratory virus activity levels, including Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), but does not confirm, suspect, or report any specific outbreak or event. It is a general update on public health trends. [news-cfa885893a834f08]
The 2026 respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) season has ended, as reported by the National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD). [news-ff7f507fa0d2a4ff]

Low RSV vaccine coverage among older Canadians is reported, with only 34% of those aged 75 years or older and 21% of those aged 60-74 years with chronic conditions being vaccinated. The National Advisory Committee on Immunization (NACI) recommends vaccination for these groups, but provincial funding varies. [news-c2ffe2771d68424e]

The American Lung Association launched a campaign to educate people living with lung disease and other risk factors about the importance of annual respiratory virus vaccines to prevent severe illness, complications, and hospitalization. This is a recommended preventive measure, not a confirmed outbreak. [news-349823f12bde8625]

papers.title: Respiratory syncytial virus-induced ADAM17 activity controls maintenance of epithelial barrier integrity and promotes syncytium formation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection causes epithelial injury, barrier disruption, and formation of syncytia in human lung tissue; however, the regulatory host defense mechanisms involved remain poorly defined. ADAM17 is a multifunctional sheddase implicated in inflammatory lung disease and is considered a potential therapeutic target during viral infections. Here, we show that RSV infection induces ADAM17 activity through PKC- and ERK-dependent signaling, increasing surface ADAM17 levels and sheddase activity. Genetic loss or pharmacological inhibition of ADAM17 reduced RSV-induced formation of syncytia, post-entry viral spread, and viral titers. This identifies ADAM17 as a host factor that supports viral dissemination. ADAM17 deficiency simultaneously exacerbated RSV-induced epithelial injury, characterized by loss of intercellular cohesion, impaired barrier function, increased paracellular permeability, and enhanced cytotoxicity. RSV-induced ADAM17 activity promoted the release of multiple epithelial growth factor receptor (EGFR) ligands. Supplementation with recombinant amphiregulin partially restored barrier function in infected ADAM17-deficient cells. Consistent with these functional effects, ADAM17 deficiency was associated with the loss of epithelial differentiation-associated transcriptional programs and increased expression of inflammatory genes. These findings indicate that ADAM17 plays a dual role in RSV infection. It facilitates syncytial viral spread, while preserving epithelial integrity through autocrine EGFR signaling. Thus, ADAM17 activity represents a biological trade-off between viral dissemination and tissue protection, indicating that therapeutic ADAM17 inhibition may reduce viral spread at the cost of aggravating epithelial damage. IMPORTANCE During respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, the airway epithelium must maintain barrier integrity while responding to virus-induced syncytium formation and tissue damage. It is poorly understood which host factors balance tissue preservation against viral replication and spread. Here, we demonstrate that the host cellular metalloproteinase ADAM17 is activated upon RSV infection. While RSV-induced ADAM17 activity promotes syncytium formation and viral spread, it concurrently controls the maintenance of epithelial barrier integrity, preserves cell survival, and inhibits hyperinflammatory signaling. By demonstrating that ADAM17 has a dual mode of action controlling both viral propagation and epithelial barrier resilience, this work uncovers a central trade-off: the same host factor exploited by RSV for dissemination is essential for protecting airway tissue. Consequently, targeting ADAM17 for antiviral therapy presents major challenges, as blocking viral spread may compromise vital epithelial defenses.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of ADAM17 in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, revealing that RSV-induced ADAM17 activity promotes syncytium formation and viral spread while maintaining epithelial barrier integrity. The research demonstrates that genetic or pharmacological inhibition of ADAM17 reduces viral dissemination but may compromise epithelial defenses. These findings highlight a dual role for ADAM17 in RSV infection, balancing viral propagation with tissue protection. The study provides moderate confidence in its conclusions, as it focuses on functional effects in a controlled setting without addressing broader clinical implications. The results suggest that targeting ADAM17 for antiviral therapy may present challenges due to its essential role in preserving epithelial integrity. This work identifies ADAM17 as a key host factor in RSV pathogenesis and underscores the need for further research into its therapeutic potential and limitations.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 感染导致人类肺组织上皮损伤、屏障破坏以及融合体的形成;然而,涉及的调控 宿主 防御机制仍尚未明确。ADAM17 是一种多功能的分离酶,参与炎症性肺病,被视为病毒感染期间的潜在治疗靶点。在此,我们展示 RSV 感染通过 PKC- 和 ERK 依赖性信号激活 ADAM17,提高其表面水平和分离酶活性。遗传性敲除或药物抑制 ADAM17 减少了 RSV 诱导的融合体形成、病毒进入后的传播以及病毒滴度。这表明 ADAM17 是一种 宿主 因子,促进病毒传播。ADAM17 缺失同时加重了 RSV 诱导的上皮损伤,表现为细胞间结合丧失、屏障功能受损、间隙通透性增加以及细胞毒性增强。RSV 诱导的 ADAM17 活性促进了多种上皮生长因子受体 (EGFR) 配体的释放。使用重组表皮生长因子受体配体部分恢复了 ADAM17 缺失细胞的屏障功能。与这些功能效应一致,ADAM17 缺失导致与上皮分化相关的转录程序丧失,并上调炎症基因的表达。这些发现表明 ADAM17 在 RSV 感染中发挥双重作用。它促进融合体病毒传播,同时通过自激素样 EGFR 信号通路保护上皮完整性。因此,ADAM17 活性代表了病毒传播与组织保护之间的生物权衡,表明治疗性 ADAM17 抑制可能降低病毒传播,但会加剧上皮损伤。在 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 感染期间,气道上皮必须维持屏障完整性,同时应对病毒诱导的融合体形成和组织损伤。目前尚不清楚哪些 宿主 因子在组织保护与病毒复制及传播之间取得平衡。在此,我们展示 宿主 细胞金属蛋白酶 ADAM17 在 RSV 感染时被激活。尽管 RSV 诱导的 ADAM17 活性促进融合体形成和病毒传播,它同时调控上皮屏障完整性的维持、细胞存活的保护以及抑制超炎症信号。通过表明 ADAM17 同时控制病毒传播和上皮屏障韧性,本研究揭示了一个核心权衡:同一被 RSV 利用于传播的 宿主 因子对于保护气道组织至关重要。因此,针对 抗病毒药物 疗法的 ADAM17 靶向面临重大挑战,因为阻断病毒传播可能削弱重要的上皮屏障防护。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: RSV感染导致上皮损伤、屏障破坏和合胞体形成,但参与的调节宿主防御机制仍不清楚。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究调查了RSV诱导的ADAM17活性在人肺组织中的作用,证明其在促进合胞体形成和病毒传播的同时控制上皮屏障完整性。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究使用遗传缺失和药理学抑制ADAM17来评估其对RSV诱导的合胞体形成、病毒入胞后传播和病毒滴度的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 遗传缺失或药理学抑制ADAM17减少了RSV诱导的合胞体形成、病毒入胞后传播和病毒滴度。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现将ADAM17识别为支持病毒传播的宿主因子,突显了其在RSV感染中的双重作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明ADAM17活性代表了病毒传播和组织保护之间的生物学权衡,这可能为未来的治疗策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究通过证明ADAM17抑制在RSV感染中的功能效应提供了中等信心,但未解决更广泛的临床意义或长期结果。

papers.title: Molecular detection of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in hospitalized children at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo
papers.abstract: Epidemiological Respiratory viral infections are among the most common diseases responsible for morbidity and mortality among children in sub-Saharan Africa, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) being a major contributor. This situation highlights the urgent need for rapid and accurate diagnostic tools. The objective of this study was to detect RSV among hospitalized children under five years of age with acute respiratory infections at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville in the Republic of the Congo. A total of 81 nasopharyngeal swab samples were collected from children aged ≤5 years who were admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit and Neonatology Department of the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville with acute respiratory infections between August and December 2023. Respiratory viruses were identified using rapid antigen detection assays and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). Rapid antigen tests detected SARS-CoV-2 in 2 cases (2.5%), whereas RSV and influenza A and B were not detected. In contrast, RT-qPCR identified RSV in 4 samples (4.9%). All RSV-positive patients were male, aged over 28 days, and hospitalized in the pediatric intensive care unit. The main clinical signs observed were respiratory distress (100%), cough (75%), fever (50%) and rhinorrhea (50%). These findings confirm the circulation of RSV among hospitalized children at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville and highlight the superior sensitivity of RT-qPCR over rapid antigen tests for RSV detection. Key words: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), children, rapid antigen test, reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), Brazzaville.

INTRODUCTION Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is an enveloped Ribonucleic Acid (RNA) virus from the Pneumoviridae family that primarily affects the respiratory system. It remains a significant public health concern, especially 212 Afr. J. Microbiol. Res. among young children (Lodi et al., 2024). In 2019, the World Health Organization (WHO) estimated that RSV caused approximately 33 million cases of acute lower respiratory infections (ALRI) in children under five, leading to 3.6 million hospitalizations and between 26,000 and 101,000 deaths globally. Alarmingly, 99% of these cases occurred in developing countries, where fragile environmental conditions and limited access to healthcare services worsen the impact (Abrams et al., 2024). RSV is now recognized as the third leading cause of lower respiratory tract infection-related deaths in young children, following Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae type A and B (Strandell et al., 2025). The virus spreads primarily through contact with nasal or oral secretions, either directly via respiratory droplets or indirectly via contaminated surfaces such as toys, bedding, or hands (Khasawneh et al., 2024). Beyond the acute infection, RSV often has long-term health consequences. Many children experience recurrent wheezing, and some go on to develop asthma, highlighting the virus’s lasting impact (Binns et al., 2022). Diagnosis involves both clinical and laboratory assessment. Common symptoms include respiratory distress, cough, fever, and nasal discharge. Virological confirmation is typically performed via antigen detection or reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) testing (Zuurbier et al., 2022). In sub-Saharan Africa, specific epidemiological data on RSV remain limited. Nonetheless, studies from countries such as Cameroon and Burkina Faso have identified RSV as one of the leading viral pathogens among children hospitalized with acute respiratory infections, underscoring its substantial burden in the region (Kouakou et al., 2021). However, in the Republic of the Congo, little information exists regarding RSV epidemiology. Despite frequent hospital admissions and the common use of empirical antibiotic treatments based on presumptive clinical diagnosis, there is a lack of documented data. Given the known impact of RSV on child health, it is crucial to provide baseline epidemiological knowledge on RSV infection in children aged 0 to 5 years in the Republic of the Congo. Such data are essential for guiding appropriate public health strategies and improving pediatric respiratory care in the country. This study aimed to detect RSV among hospitalized children at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo. MATERIAL AND METHODS Study design A cross-sectional study was conducted at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo, from August to December 2023. Patients were recruited based on structured inclusion criteria. Sociodemographic and clinical data were collected using a standardized questionnaire. Biological samples were collected and subsequently analyzed at the Molecular Biology Laboratory of the Marie Madeleine Gombes Foundation in Pointe- Noire. Study population and enrollment criteria The study was conducted among children admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit and the Neonatology Department of the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville to determine the prevalence of circulating RSV. Children aged ≤5 years presenting with clinical signs of acute respiratory infection and whose parents or legal guardians provided informed consent were included. Children older than 5 years or those without parental or legal guardian consent were excluded. Sociodemographic and clinical information, including fever, respiratory distress, cough, rhinorrhea and cyanosis was collected using a standardized questionnaire. Sample size The sample size for this study was calculated using Schwartz’s formula. Due to the lack of existing epidemiological data on RSV in the Republic of the Congo, prevalence data from a previous study conducted in Gabon, a country bordering Congo were used as a reference (Lekana-Douki et al., 2014). That study reported an estimated RSV prevalence of 13.5% (p = 0.135) among children. Based on this prevalence, the minimum sample size required for our study was calculated approximately 179 participants. Sample collection A total of 81 children meeting the predefined eligibility criteria were enrolled during the study period, including 39 patients admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit and 42 admitted to the Neonatology Department. Nasopharyngeal swab samples were collected from all enrolled participants, placed in a cooler with ice packs, and transported to the laboratory for RSV analysis. Seropositivity and molecular detection of viruses Rapid antigen detection of respiratory viruses Rapid detection of RSV was performed using an immunochromatographic rapid test (BIOSYNEX, France), which also allowed the simultaneous detection of other respiratory virus antigens Influenza A virus (Flu A), Influenza B virus (Flu B), and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), according to the manufacturer’s instructions (Neal et al., 2024). RT-qPCR detection of RSV Viral RNA was extracted from nasopharyngeal swab samples using the Norgen Biotek RNA extraction kit (Norgen Biotek Corp., Thorold, *Corresponding author. Molecular detection of RSV was performed using the NZY Multiplex RT-qPCR COVID-19, Flu A/B and RSV kit (NZYTech, Lisbon, Portugal). The assay targets the RSV L and RP human gene using a specific primer/probe set labeled with the FAM fluorophore. Human RNase P amplification (HEX/VIC channel) was used as an internal control. Each run included manufacturer-provided positive and negative controls. Reverse transcription was performed at 50°C for 10 min to synthesize complementary DNA (cDNA) from viral RNA, followed by initial denaturation at 95°C for 3 min and 40 amplification Moyen et al. 213 cycles consisting of denaturation at 95°C for 5 s and combined annealing/extension at 60°C for 30 s. RSV positivity was defined by a sigmoidal amplification curve in the FAM channel with a Ct value ≤35. Statistical analysis Data were entered into Microsoft Excel (version 2016) and were analyzed using IBM SPSS Statistics for Windows (version 25.0, IBM Corp., Armonk, NY, USA). Categorical variables were presented as frequencies and percentages, while continuous variables were expressed as mean ± standard deviation (SD) or median with minimum and maximum, as appropriate. Fisher’s exact test was used when appropriate, with statistical significance set at a two-tailed p- value < 0.05. Ethical consideration This study was reviewed and approved by the Health Research Ethics Committee under approval number No. 113- 24/MESRSIT/DGRST/CERSSA/24. The clinical characteristics of children tested for RSV are shown in Table 5 DISCUSSION This study aimed to detect RSV among hospitalized children at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo. The analysis evaluated the presence of respiratory viruses in 81 children under 5 years of age with acute respiratory infections. Rapid antigen testing revealed no cases of RSV or influenza A and B, while SARS-CoV-2 antigens were detected in two children. These findings contrast with those reported by Aneja et al. (2024), who observed a higher RSV prevalence (30%) among children with respiratory infections. Complementary molecular diagnosis using RT- qPCR revealed that 4 (4.9%) children had an acute RSV infection, although all samples tested negative by rapid antigen detection. These findings are consistent with Moyen et al. 215 Table 5. Clinical characteristics of children tested for RSV by RT-qPCR. Variable Positive n (%) Negative n (%) p-value Respiratory distress - Oui 4 (100.0) 77 (100.0) Non 0 (0.0) 0 (0.0) Cough - Oui 3 (75.0) 34 (44.2) Non 1 (25.0) 43 (55.8) Fever - Oui 2 (50.0) 29 (37.7) Non 2 (50.0) 48 (62.3) Rhinorrhea - Oui 2 (50.0) 21 (27.3) Non 2 (50.0) 56 (72.7) Cyanosis - Oui 0 (0.0) 1 (1.3) Non 4 (100.0) 76 (98.7) previous studies (Mesquita et al., 2017), reporting RSV detection among children with acute respiratory infections using RT-qPCR. These results further support the higher sensitivity of molecular methods compared with antigen- based rapid tests for RSV detection. However, the RSV positivity rate observed in this study was lower than that reported in several neighboring African countries, where RSV detection rates among children with acute respiratory infections have generally ranged from approximately 10% to more than 30%, including reports from Gabon and Cameroon (Mandi et al., 2021). Differences in RSV prevalence between studies may be explained by several factors, including variations in epidemiological context, viral circulation patterns and seasonal trends found in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Mufwaya et al., 2025). Regarding sociodemographic parameters, our study showed that all four positive cases were male sex. Several hospital-based studies have reported a similar trend (Aneja et al., 2024). This male predominance may be explained by the relatively narrower bronchi in boys, which may increase susceptibility to respiratory infections. The age group older than 28 days was the most affected, with a positivity rate of 100% in this category. Main clinical signs observed in RSV-positive children were respiratory distress (100%), cough (75%), fever (50%) and rhinorrhea (50%). Similar predominant symptoms have been reported by Bhandary and Boloor (2016), with cough (81.8%) and respiratory distress (68.2%) being the most frequently observed. Breastfeeding practices and maternal education may influence RSV infection risk. However, in this study, no statistically significant association was observed between breastfeeding practices and RSV positivity. Regarding maternal education, most mothers had a primary education level 41 (50.6%), although maternal education can influence hygiene practices, early recognition of symptoms and healthcare behaviors. These factors should be considered in future studies to better understand RSV risk determinants (Parikh, 2023). Although the study did not cover all seasons, the detection of RSV, despite a low positivity rate, confirms its circulation among children hospitalized for acute respiratory infections in Brazzaville. This study has several limitations that should be highlighted. First, the sample size was smaller than originally planned: while the initial power calculation targeted 179 participants, only 81 children were enrolled due to the refusal of some parents or guardians. Second, the study duration was relatively short and did not cover all seasonal cycles over a full year, which did not allow for a complete assessment of the seasonal dynamics and peak transmission periods of the virus during this time. Therefore, future prospective multicenter studies covering full annual cycles with larger cohorts are recommended to better characterize the epidemiology and clinical burden of RSV in this region. Conclusion This study confirms the circulation of RSV among children under five years of age at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville, with a positivity rate of 4.9% detected by 216 Afr. J. Microbiol. Res. RT-qPCR. These findings highlight the superior sensitivity of RT-qPCR compared with rapid antigen detection tests for RSV detection and underline the necessity of using molecular diagnostics inaccurately identify viral infections in pediatric populations. analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to detect respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in hospitalized children under five years of age with acute respiratory infections at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo. A total of 81 nasopharyngeal swab samples were collected between August and December 2023. Rapid antigen detection assays identified SARS-CoV-2 in 2 cases (2.5%), but RSV and influenza A and B were not detected. In contrast, RT-qPCR identified RSV in 4 samples (4.9%). All RSV-positive patients were male, aged over 28 days, and hospitalized in the pediatric intensive care unit. The main clinical signs observed were respiratory distress (100%), cough (75%), fever (50%) and rhinorrhea (50%). These findings confirm the circulation of RSV in this setting and highlight the superior sensitivity of RT-qPCR over rapid antigen tests for RSV detection. The study provides important insights into the diagnostic challenges of RSV in sub-Saharan Africa and underscores the need for more sensitive testing methods in clinical practice.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: Respiratory viral infections are among the most common diseases responsible for morbidity and mortality among children in sub-Saharan Africa, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) being a major contributor.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The objective of this study was to detect RSV among hospitalized children under five years of age with acute respiratory infections at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville in the Republic of the Congo. A total of 81 nasopharyngeal swab samples were collected from children aged ≤5 years who were admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit and Neonatology Department of the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville with acute respiratory infections between August and December 2023.
elements_en.methods: Respiratory viruses were identified using rapid antigen detection assays and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR).
elements_en.main_results: Rapid antigen tests detected SARS-CoV-2 in 2 cases (2.5%), whereas RSV and influenza A and B were not detected. In contrast, RT-qPCR identified RSV in 4 samples (4.9%).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings confirm the circulation of RSV among hospitalized children at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville and highlight the superior sensitivity of RT-qPCR over rapid antigen tests for RSV detection.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of using RT-qPCR for accurate RSV detection in clinical settings, which can inform improved diagnostic strategies and surveillance in sub-Saharan Africa.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by its focus on hospitalized children and the use of a single diagnostic method, but the evidence is strong as it directly reports RSV detection using RT-qPCR in a specific population and setting.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究的目的是检测在刚果共和国布拉扎扎维尔大学医院中心因急性呼吸道感染而住院的5岁以下儿童中的RSV。在2023年8月至12月期间,共从布拉扎扎维尔大学医院中心儿科重症监护室和新生儿科收治的年龄≤5岁的急性呼吸道感染儿童中收集了81份鼻咽拭子样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用快速抗原检测试验和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)鉴定呼吸道病毒。
elements_zh.main_results: 快速抗原检测试验在2例(2.5%)中检测到SARS-CoV-2,而RSV和流感A、B型病毒均未被检测到。相比之下,RT-qPCR在4份样本(4.9%)中检测到RSV。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现证实了RSV在刚果共和国布拉扎维尔大学医院中心住院儿童中的流行,并突显了RT-qPCR在RSV检测中相较于快速抗原检测试验的更高灵敏度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在临床环境中使用RT-qPCR进行RSV准确检测的重要性,这可以为改善撒哈拉以南非洲的诊断策略和监测提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其仅针对住院儿童,并且使用了单一的诊断方法,但证据强度较高,因为它直接在特定人群和环境中报告了RSV的检测结果。

papers.title_zh: 刚果共和国布拉扎维尔大学医院中心住院儿童中呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)的分子检测
papers.source_body_en: Epidemiological Respiratory viral infections are among the most common diseases responsible for morbidity and mortality among children in sub-Saharan Africa, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) being a major contributor. This situation highlights the urgent need for rapid and accurate diagnostic tools. The objective of this study was to detect RSV among hospitalized children under five years of age with acute respiratory infections at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville in the Republic of the Congo. A total of 81 nasopharyngeal swab samples were collected from children aged ≤5 years who were admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit and Neonatology Department of the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville with acute respiratory infections between August and December 2023. Respiratory viruses were identified using rapid antigen detection assays and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). Rapid antigen tests detected SARS-CoV-2 in 2 cases (2.5%), whereas RSV and influenza A and B were not detected. In contrast, RT-qPCR identified RSV in 4 samples (4.9%). All RSV-positive patients were male, aged over 28 days, and hospitalized in the pediatric intensive care unit. The main clinical signs observed were respiratory distress (100%), cough (75%), fever (50%) and rhinorrhea (50%). These findings confirm the circulation of RSV among hospitalized children at the University Hospital Center of Brazzaville and highlight the superior sensitivity of RT-qPCR over rapid antigen tests for RSV detection. Key words: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), children, rapid antigen test, reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), Brazzaville.
papers.abstract_zh: 流行病学呼吸道病毒感染是撒哈拉以南非洲儿童发病率和死亡率的主要原因之一,其中呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是主要贡献者。这一情况凸显了快速准确诊断工具的迫切需求。本研究的目的是检测刚果共和国布拉扎维尔大学医院中心住院的5岁以下急性呼吸道感染儿童中的RSV。2023年8月至12月期间,从布拉扎维尔大学医院中心儿科重症监护室和新生儿科收治的年龄≤5岁的儿童中收集了81份鼻咽拭子样本。使用快速抗原检测试验和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)鉴定呼吸道病毒。快速抗原检测试验在2例(2.5%)中检测到SARS-CoV-2,而RSV和流感A、B型病毒均未被检测到。相比之下,RT-qPCR在4份样本(4.9%)中检测到RSV。所有RSV阳性患者均为男性,年龄超过28天,并住院在儿科重症监护室。观察到的主要临床症状包括呼吸窘迫(100%)、咳嗽(75%)、发热(50%)和流涕(50%)。这些发现证实了RSV在刚果共和国布拉扎维尔大学医院中心住院儿童中的流行,并突显了RT-qPCR在RSV检测中相较于快速抗原检测试验的更高灵敏度。关键词:呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)、儿童、快速抗原检测、逆转录定量聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)、布拉扎维尔。

papers.title: Development and Validation of machine learning models for early prediction of severe Respiratory Syncytial Virus pneumonia in children
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is a leading cause of severe respiratory infections, particularly pneumonia, in children, especially those under the age of five. The incidence of severe RSV pneumonia has risen in recent years, underscoring the need for an effective predictive tool. Therefore, the development and validation of a model to predict the severity of RSV pneumonia in pediatric patients is essential. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted involving 180 children with confirmed RSV pneumonia, categorized into severe (n = 62) and non-severe (n = 118) groups. Clinical, laboratory, and imaging data were collected at admission. Features selection was performed using LASSO regression and the Boruta algorithm. Subsequently, eight machine learning models were developed, including Logistic Regression, Multilayer Perceptron, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, Random Forest (RF), AdaBoost, and Extreme Gradient Boosting. Model performance was evaluated using standard metrics, such as area under the curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and F1 score. Additionally, Decision Curve Analysis (DCA) was employed to assess the clinical utility of the models. SHAP analysis was performed to evaluate model interpretation. Results Seven features were identified for model development. Among the models, RF exhibited the best performance, with an AUC of 0.853, sensitivity of 0.895, specificity of 0.714, accuracy of 0.778, and F1-score of 0.739 in the testing cohort. DCA demonstrated that the RF model provided a significant net benefit, indicating its clinical utility for early intervention. SHAP analysis revealed that respiratory rate and shortness of breath were the most influential features in predicting severe RSV pneumonia. Conclusion The RF model demonstrated strong predictive performance for identifying severe RSV pneumonia in children, providing a novel approach for early detection and timely intervention. Notably, this study is the first to apply machine learning for predicting severe RSV pneumonia in pediatric patients using clinical data collected at admission.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop and validate machine learning models for early prediction of severe Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) pneumonia in children. Clinical, laboratory, and imaging data were collected at admission, and features were selected using LASSO regression and the Boruta algorithm. Eight machine learning models were developed, with Random Forest (RF) showing the best performance, achieving an AUC of 0.853, sensitivity of 0.895, specificity of 0.714, accuracy of 0.778, and F1-score of 0.739. The study's retrospective design and potential for selection bias limit its evidence strength, though the results suggest moderate confidence in the model's utility.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究回顾性分析了180名确诊RSV肺炎的儿童,分为严重组(n = 62)和非严重组(n = 118)。在入院时收集了临床、实验室和影像学数据。

elements_zh.main_results: 确定了七个特征用于模型开发。在测试集队列研究中,随机森林(RF)模型表现最佳,其AUC为0.853,灵敏度为0.895,特异度为0.714,准确率为0.778,F1分数为0.739。DCA显示RF模型提供了显著的净获益,表明其在早期干预中的临床实用性。SHAP分析表明,呼吸频率和呼吸困难是预测严重RSV肺炎的最关键特征。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 随机森林模型在识别儿童严重RSV肺炎方面表现出强大的预测性能,为早期检测和及时干预提供了新的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于开发早期监测系统,并指导对严重RSV肺炎风险儿童的及时临床干预。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计和可能的选择偏倚。然而,模型的性能指标表明其在预测严重RSV肺炎方面的临床实用性具有中等证据。

papers.title_zh: 儿童早期预测严重呼吸道合胞病毒肺炎的机器学习模型开发与验证
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is a leading cause of severe respiratory infections, particularly pneumonia, in children, especially those under the age of five. The incidence of severe RSV pneumonia has risen in recent years, underscoring the need for an effective predictive tool. Therefore, the development and validation of a model to predict the severity of RSV pneumonia in pediatric patients is essential. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted involving 180 children with confirmed RSV pneumonia, categorized into severe (n = 62) and non-severe (n = 118) groups. Clinical, laboratory, and imaging data were collected at admission. Features selection was performed using LASSO regression and the Boruta algorithm. Subsequently, eight machine learning models were developed, including Logistic Regression, Multilayer Perceptron, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, Random Forest (RF), AdaBoost, and Extreme Gradient Boosting. Model performance was evaluated using standard metrics, such as area under the curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and F1 score. Additionally, Decision Curve Analysis (DCA) was employed to assess the clinical utility of the models. SHAP analysis was performed to evaluate model interpretation. Results Seven features were identified for model development. Among the models, RF exhibited the best performance, with an AUC of 0.853, sensitivity of 0.895, specificity of 0.714, accuracy of 0.778, and F1-score of 0.739 in the testing cohort. DCA demonstrated that the RF model provided a significant net benefit, indicating its clinical utility for early intervention. SHAP analysis revealed that respiratory rate and shortness of breath were the most influential features in predicting severe RSV pneumonia. Conclusion The RF model demonstrated strong predictive performance for identifying severe RSV pneumonia in children, providing a novel approach for early detection and timely intervention. Notably, this study is the first to apply machine learning for predicting severe RSV pneumonia in pediatric patients using clinical data collected at admission.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是导致儿童严重呼吸道感染,尤其是肺炎的主要原因之一,特别是五岁以下的儿童。近年来,严重RSV肺炎的发生率有所上升,凸显了开发有效预测工具的必要性。因此,开发和验证一种用于预测儿童RSV肺炎严重程度的模型至关重要。方法 本研究回顾性分析了180名确诊RSV肺炎的儿童,分为严重组(n = 62)和非严重组(n = 118)。在入院时收集了临床、实验室和影像学数据。使用LASSO回归和Boruta算法进行特征选择。随后,开发了八种机器学习模型,包括逻辑回归、多层感知机、支持向量机、决策树、随机森林(RF)、AdaBoost和极端梯度提升。模型性能通过标准指标进行评估,如曲线下面积(AUC)、灵敏度、特异度、准确率和F1分数。此外,采用决策曲线分析(DCA)评估模型的临床实用性。通过SHAP分析评估模型的可解释性。结果 确定了七个特征用于模型开发。在测试集队列研究中,随机森林(RF)模型表现最佳,其AUC为0.853,灵敏度为0.895,特异度为0.714,准确率为0.778,F1分数为0.739。DCA显示RF模型提供了显著的净获益,表明其在早期干预中的临床实用性。SHAP分析表明,呼吸频率和呼吸困难是预测严重RSV肺炎的最关键特征。结论 随机森林模型在识别儿童严重RSV肺炎方面表现出强大的预测性能,为早期检测和及时干预提供了新的方法。值得注意的是,本研究是首个利用入院时收集的临床数据,通过机器学习预测儿童严重RSV肺炎的研究。

papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)–An Urgent Priority in Respiratory Disease Prevention
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of lower respiratory tract disease in infants, young children, older adults, and individuals with cardiopulmonary comorbidities or immunocompromised states. Recent advances enable layered prevention through maternal vaccination for infant protection, long-acting monoclonal antibodies for newborns and select toddlers, and vaccines for older adults. However, inequities in surveillance, seasonality-driven timing, and challenges in affordability and delivery—particularly in low- and middle-income countries— impede equitable uptake. This editorial underscores priority populations, synthesizes current evidence and policy directions, and outlines actionable levers in financing, procurement, and integrated maternal–child health delivery to accelerate access, making RSV prevention an urgent and achievable global health priority.

papers.title: Integrin-FAK signaling dependent non-canonical ISGylation by extracellular ISG15 restricts human respiratory syncytial virus infection in epithelial cells
papers.abstract: Interferons (IFN) induce cellular proteins with antiviral activity. One such protein is Interferon Stimulated Gene 15 (ISG15). ISG15 is conjugated to target cellular proteins through ISGylation to confer antiviral activity and can regulate cellular processes associated with infectious, inflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases, and cancer. Apart from ISGylation, unconjugated free ISG15 is also released from cells during various conditions, including virus infection. The role of extracellular ISG15 during virus infection is poorly understood. Additionally, it was unknown whether extracellular ISG15 can activate IFN independent ISGylation via activation of alternative cellular signaling pathway. We have used IFN and IFN signaling incompetent epithelial cells infected with human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) or treated with purified human ISG15 protein. Additional studies were conducted with IFN competent cells treated with IFN signaling inhibitors, along with extracellular ISG15 blocking antibody and immunofluorescence analysis to demonstrate the role of extracellular ISG15 during virus infection. The involvement of integrin-Focal Adhesion Kinase (FAK) pathway during this event was investigated by using integrin-FAK pathway inhibitors and mutant ISG15 protein (generated based on in silico modeling) that failed to interact with integrin. To demonstrate post-translational regulation, protein chase experiment was performed with protein synthesis inhibitor treated cells. We have identified an alternative non-canonical ISGylation route initiated by extracellular ISG15 and mediated by integrin-FAK signaling, in contrast to the classical IFN-driven ISGylation. We show that extracellular ISG15 acts as a soluble antiviral factor that triggers IFN independent ISGylation and restricts virus infection in epithelial cells. Specifically, extracellular ISG15 engages with cell surface integrins via its RGD-like motif to activate the integrin-FAK pathway, resulting in IFN-independent ISGylation. Furthermore, in the absence of ISG15 transcriptional upregulation, extracellular ISG15 enhances the post-translational stability of basal intracellular ISG15 protein to support ISGylation. Thus, our studies have identified extracellular ISG15 as an antiviral factor that promotes non-canonical IFN independent ISGylation through integrin-FAK signaling and post-translational stabilization of intracellular ISG15 protein. source_records.abstract: Interferons (IFN) induce cellular proteins with antiviral activity. One such protein is Interferon Stimulated Gene 15 (ISG15). ISG15 is conjugated to target cellular proteins through ISGylation to confer antiviral activity and can regulate cellular processes associated with infectious, inflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases, and cancer. Apart from ISGylation, unconjugated free ISG15 is also released from cells during various conditions, including virus infection. The role of extracellular ISG15 during virus infection is poorly understood. Additionally, it was unknown whether extracellular ISG15 can activate IFN independent ISGylation via activation of alternative cellular signaling pathway. We have used IFN and IFN signaling incompetent epithelial cells infected with human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) or treated with purified human ISG15 protein. Additional studies were conducted with IFN competent cells treated with IFN signaling inhibitors, along with extracellular ISG15 blocking antibody and immunofluorescence analysis to demonstrate the role of extracellular ISG15 during virus infection. The involvement of integrin-Focal Adhesion Kinase (FAK) pathway during this event was investigated by using integrin-FAK pathway inhibitors and mutant ISG15 protein (generated based on in silico modeling) that failed to interact with integrin. To demonstrate post-translational regulation, protein chase experiment was performed with protein synthesis inhibitor treated cells. We have identified an alternative non-canonical ISGylation route initiated by extracellular ISG15 and mediated by integrin-FAK signaling, in contrast to the classical IFN-driven ISGylation. We show that extracellular ISG15 acts as a soluble antiviral factor that triggers IFN independent ISGylation and restricts virus infection in epithelial cells. Specifically, extracellular ISG15 engages with cell surface integrins via its RGD-like motif to activate the integrin-FAK pathway, resulting in IFN-independent ISGylation. Furthermore, in the absence of ISG15 transcriptional upregulation, extracellular ISG15 enhances the post-translational stability of basal intracellular ISG15 protein to support ISGylation. Thus, our studies have identified extracellular ISG15 as an antiviral factor that promotes non-canonical IFN independent ISGylation through integrin-FAK signaling and post-translational stabilization of intracellular ISG15 protein. Because ISG15 and ISGylation influence diverse infectious, inflammatory, and degenerative conditions, this alternative ISGylation route has broad implications for antiviral immunity, disease resolution, and development of host-directed therapeutic strategies for various diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨细胞外ISG15在人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染期间对抗病毒药物活性的作用,以及它是否能通过替代的细胞信号通路激活IFN独立的ISGylation。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了IFN和IFN信号功能缺陷的上皮细胞,这些细胞被人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染或用纯化的ISG15蛋白处理。此外,还进行了IFN功能正常的细胞处理IFN信号抑制剂、细胞外ISG15阻断抗体以及免疫荧光分析。
elements_zh.methods: 方法包括使用整合素-FAK通路抑制剂和基于计算机建模生成的无法与整合素相互作用的ISG15突变体蛋白。还进行了蛋白质追踪实验,使用了蛋白质合成抑制剂处理的细胞以展示翻译后调控。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究确定了一条由细胞外ISG15启动、通过整合素-FAK信号介导的替代非经典ISGylation途径,与经典的IFN驱动的ISGylation不同。此外,还表明细胞外ISG15在缺乏ISG15转录上调的情况下增强了基础细胞内ISG15蛋白的翻译后稳定性,以支持ISGylation。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为细胞外ISG15作为一种可溶性抗病毒药物因子,能够触发IFN独立的ISGylation并限制上皮细胞中的病毒感染。这代表了一种新的抗病毒药物免疫机制,涉及整合素-FAK信号。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对抗病毒药物免疫、疾病缓解以及针对各种疾病的宿主定向治疗策略具有广泛意义,包括呼吸道合胞病毒感染。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据基于使用IFN信号功能缺陷细胞和抑制剂的体外实验,这可能限制其在体内环境中的普遍适用性。由于依赖细胞培养模型且缺乏临床数据,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 干扰素(IFN)诱导具有抗病毒药物活性的细胞蛋白。其中一种是干扰素刺激基因15(ISG15)。ISG15通过ISGylation连接到靶向细胞蛋白上,以赋予抗病毒药物活性,并可调节与感染、炎症和神经退行性疾病以及癌症相关的细胞过程。除了ISGylation之外,细胞外的ISG15在多种条件下也会被释放,包括病毒感染。细胞外ISG15在病毒感染中的作用尚不清楚。此外,尚不清楚细胞外ISG15是否能通过激活替代的细胞信号通路来激活IFN独立的ISGylation。我们使用了IFN和IFN信号功能缺陷的上皮细胞,这些细胞被人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染或用纯化的ISG15蛋白处理。此外,还进行了IFN功能正常的细胞处理IFN信号抑制剂、细胞外ISG15阻断抗体以及免疫荧光分析,以展示细胞外ISG15在病毒感染中的作用。通过使用整合素-FAK通路抑制剂和基于计算机建模生成的无法与整合素相互作用的ISG15突变体蛋白,研究了整合素-FAK通路在此过程中的参与情况。为了展示翻译后调控,我们进行了蛋白质追踪实验,使用了蛋白质合成抑制剂处理的细胞。我们发现了一条由细胞外ISG15启动、通过整合素-FAK信号介导的替代非经典ISGylation途径,与经典的IFN驱动的ISGylation不同。我们证明了细胞外ISG15作为一种可溶性抗病毒药物因子,能够触发IFN独立的ISGylation,并限制上皮细胞中的病毒感染。具体而言,细胞外ISG15通过其RGD样基序与细胞表面整合素结合,激活整合素-FAK通路,从而引发IFN独立的ISGylation。此外,在缺乏ISG15转录上调的情况下,细胞外ISG15增强了基础细胞内ISG15蛋白的翻译后稳定性,以支持ISGylation。因此,我们的研究确定了细胞外ISG15作为一种抗病毒药物因子,通过整合素-FAK信号和细胞内ISG15蛋白的翻译后稳定化促进非经典的IFN独立ISGylation。由于ISG15和ISGylation影响多种感染、炎症和退行性疾病,这种替代的ISGylation途径对抗病毒药物免疫、疾病缓解以及针对各种疾病的宿主定向治疗策略具有广泛意义。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨细胞外ISG15在人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染期间对抗病毒药物活性的作用,以及它是否能通过替代的细胞信号通路激活IFN独立的ISGylation。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了IFN和IFN信号功能缺陷的上皮细胞,这些细胞被人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染或用纯化的ISG15蛋白处理。此外,还进行了IFN功能正常的细胞处理IFN信号抑制剂、细胞外ISG15阻断抗体以及免疫荧光分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 方法包括使用整合素-FAK通路抑制剂和基于计算机建模生成的无法与整合素相互作用的ISG15突变体蛋白。还进行了蛋白质追踪实验,使用了蛋白质合成抑制剂处理的细胞以展示翻译后调控。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究确定了一条由细胞外ISG15启动、通过整合素-FAK信号介导的替代非经典ISGylation途径,与经典的IFN驱动的ISGylation不同。此外,还表明细胞外ISG15在缺乏ISG15转录上调的情况下增强了基础细胞内ISG15蛋白的翻译后稳定性,以支持ISGylation。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为细胞外ISG15作为一种可溶性抗病毒药物因子,能够触发IFN独立的ISGylation并限制上皮细胞中的病毒感染。这代表了一种新的抗病毒药物免疫机制,涉及整合素-FAK信号。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对抗病毒药物免疫、疾病缓解以及针对各种疾病的宿主定向治疗策略具有广泛意义,包括呼吸道合胞病毒感染。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据基于使用IFN信号功能缺陷细胞和抑制剂的体外实验,这可能限制其在体内环境中的普遍适用性。由于依赖细胞培养模型且缺乏临床数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Maternal vaccination against COVID-19, influenza, pertussis, and respiratory syncytial virus: a scoping review
papers.abstract: Abstract Pregnancy and early infancy are periods of heightened vulnerability, with SARS-CoV-2 and influenza infections potentially linked to adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth and stillbirth. Maternal vaccination provides direct protection to mothers by active immunisation and to infants by passive immunisation. This scoping review mapped and described published literature on maternal vaccination against COVID-19, influenza, pertussis, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). It includes information on the outcome domains studied and if timing of vaccination was examined, with the aim of identifying evidence gaps and supporting decision-makers in choosing priority areas for subsequent systematic review topics. analysis.summary_en: This scoping review focuses on maternal vaccination against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), alongside other pathogens such as SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and pertussis. It highlights the importance of maternal vaccination in protecting both mothers and infants through active and passive immunisation. The review identified 635 publications, including 20 studies and 11 reviews on RSV, and found that evidence on RSV vaccination is limited. While substantial evidence exists for the efficacy, effectiveness, safety, and immunogenicity of vaccines against other pathogens, the review underscores the need for updated systematic reviews to address gaps in understanding the optimal timing of vaccination and the safety of coadministration of vaccines. papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Vaccination Strongly Induces RSVpreF-specific IgG and Neutralizing Activity in Immunocompromised Individuals.
papers.abstract: Background: Protein-based respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F (RSVpreF) vaccines show promising immunogenicity in immunocompromised individuals. We have recently shown that RSV-specific CD4 T-cell responses and IgG antibodies were significantly induced, but data on functional humoral responses as well as associations between cellular and humoral immunological endpoints remain limited. We therefore extended our previous studies and performed a head-to-head assessment of vaccine-specific RSVpreF IgG and neutralizing antibody activity across different immunocompromised populations, including kidney and lung transplant recipients, patients on hemodialysis, and patients with CKD. Methods: Conformation-specific RSVpreF-specific IgG levels and RSV-neutralizing plasma activity were assessed before and 13-18 d after RSV vaccination in 61 patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), 15 patients receiving hemodialysis, 46 kidney transplant (KTx) recipients, and 31 lung transplant (LuTx) recipients. RSVpreF-specific IgG was measured by ELISA and neutralizing activity using an RSV-pseudovirus assay. Furthermore, comprehensive correlation analyses were carried out to assess associations between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity. Results: < 0.0001), whereas correlations with CD4 T-cell responses were less pronounced. Conclusions: RSV vaccination induces robust functional humoral immunity in all tested immunocompromised patient groups, but responses are lowest in kidney transplant recipients. Among transplant recipients, responses were reduced within the first year after transplantation and in patients on MMF/MPA, supporting the need for optimized vaccination strategies in these patient groups.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, addressing the need for optimized vaccination strategies in transplant recipients and patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hemodialysis. Previous studies had shown promising CD4 T-cell responses and IgG antibodies but lacked data on functional humoral responses and associations between cellular and humoral endpoints.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated RSVpreF-specific IgG and neutralizing activity in 61 CKD patients, 15 hemodialysis patients, 46 kidney transplant recipients, and 31 lung transplant recipients, using ELISA and a pseudovirus assay.
analysis.methods: RSVpreF-specific IgG was measured by ELISA, and neutralizing activity was assessed using an RSV-pseudovirus assay. Comprehensive correlation analyses were performed to assess associations between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity.
analysis.main_results: RSV vaccination induced robust functional humoral immunity in all tested immunocompromised patient groups, with the lowest responses observed in kidney transplant recipients. Correlations with CD4 T-cell responses were less pronounced.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that RSV vaccination induces strong functional humoral immunity in various immunocompromised populations, highlighting the need for tailored vaccination strategies in kidney transplant recipients and patients on mycophenolate mofetil/methylprednisolone (MMF/MPA).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that RSV vaccination can be effective in immunocompromised individuals, but strategies may need to be optimized for kidney transplant recipients to ensure adequate protection. This has implications for surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of RSV infection in these patient groups.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample sizes and the focus on a single vaccine formulation, which may limit generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the need for further research to confirm these findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, including CKD, hemodialysis, kidney transplant, and lung transplant recipients. It demonstrated robust functional humoral immunity in all groups, with the lowest responses in kidney transplant recipients, highlighting the need for tailored vaccination strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估RSVpreF 疫苗在免疫缺陷个体中的免疫原性,以应对移植受者和慢性肾病(CKD)及血液透析患者的优化疫苗接种策略需求。先前研究表明,RSV特异性CD4 T细胞反应和IgG抗体具有前景,但缺乏关于功能性体液免疫反应以及细胞免疫和体液免疫终点之间关联的数据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了61名CKD患者、15名血液透析患者、46名肾移植受者和31名肺移植受者中RSVpreF特异性IgG和中和活性,采用ELISA和假病毒检测法。
elements_zh.methods: 通过ELISA测定RSVpreF特异性IgG,通过RSV假病毒检测法评估中和活性。进行了全面的相关性分析,以评估疫苗诱导的体液免疫参数与细胞免疫之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: RSV 疫苗接种在所有测试的免疫缺陷患者群体中诱导了强大的功能性体液免疫,其中肾移植受者的反应最低。与CD4 T细胞反应的相关性不明显。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究证明RSV 疫苗接种在多种免疫缺陷人群中诱导了强烈的功能性体液免疫,强调了在肾移植受者和接受霉酚酸酯/甲基泼尼龙(MMF/MPA)治疗的患者中制定定制化疫苗接种策略的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,RSV 疫苗接种在免疫缺陷个体中可能有效,但需要为肾移植受者优化策略以确保充分保护。这对RSV感染在这些患者群体中的监测、诊断和治疗具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括样本量较小以及仅关注一种疫苗制剂,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等,需要进一步研究以确认这些发现。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:基于蛋白的呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)前融合F(RSVpreF)疫苗在免疫缺陷个体中显示出有希望的免疫原性。我们最近的研究表明,RSV特异性CD4 T细胞反应和IgG抗体显著诱导,但关于功能性体液免疫反应的数据以及细胞免疫和体液免疫终点之间的关联仍有限。因此,我们扩展了之前的研究,并对不同免疫缺陷人群(包括肾移植和肺移植受者、接受血液透析的患者以及慢性肾病(CKD)患者)中疫苗特异性RSVpreF IgG和中和抗体活性进行了头对头评估。方法:在61名慢性肾病(CKD)患者、15名接受血液透析的患者、46名肾移植(KTx)受者和31名肺移植(LuTx)受者中,分别在接种RSV 疫苗接种前和接种后13-18天评估了构象特异性RSVpreF特异性IgG水平和RSV中和血浆活性。RSVpreF特异性IgG通过ELISA测定,中和活性则通过RSV假病毒检测法评估。此外,还进行了全面的相关性分析,以评估疫苗诱导的体液免疫参数与细胞免疫之间的关联。结果:相关性显著(< 0.0001),而与CD4 T细胞反应的相关性则不明显。结论:RSV 疫苗接种在所有测试的免疫缺陷患者群体中诱导了强大的功能性体液免疫,但肾移植受者的反应最低。在移植受者中,反应在移植后第一年以及接受MMF/MPA治疗的患者中有所下降,这支持了在这些患者群体中优化疫苗接种策略的必要性。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括样本量较小以及仅关注一种疫苗制剂,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等,需要进一步研究以确认这些发现。

papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Infection and Cardiovascular Diseases in Adults: Disease Burden, Cardiac Complications, Pathophysiology, and Prevention Strategies
papers.abstract: Öz Respiratuvar sinsityal virüs (RSV), geleneksel olarak çocukluk çağında bronşiolit ve pnömoninin önemli nedenlerinden biri olarak kabul edilmekle birlikte, günümüzde ileri yaş erişkinlerde ve kronik hastalığı bulunan bireylerde önemli bir morbidite, hastaneye yatış ve mortalite nedeni olarak tanımlanmaktadır.Özellikle kalp yetersizliği, koroner arter hastalığı ve diğer kardiyovasküler hastalıkları bulunan erişkinler ağır RSV enfeksiyonu açısından yüksek riskli bir grubu oluşturmaktadır.Bununla birlikte RSV ile kardiyovasküler sistem arasındaki ilişki tek yönlü değildir.Önceden mevcut kardiyovasküler hastalıklar RSV enfeksiyonunun ağır seyretme olasılığını artırırken, akut RSV enfeksiyonu da kalp yetersizliği dekompansasyonu, akut koroner sendrom, miyokardiyal hasar, atriyal ve ventriküler aritmiler ve diğer akut kardiyak olayların gelişimini tetikleyebilmektedir. Son yıllarda yayımlanan geniş gözlemsel çalışmalar ve sistematik derlemeler, RSV nedeniyle hastaneye yatırılan ileri yaş erişkinlerin yaklaşık beşte birinde akut kardiyak olay görülebileceğini ortaya koymuştur.Bu komplikasyonlar arasında en sık bildirilen kardiyak tablo akut kalp yetersizliğidir.Önceden kalp yetersizliği bulunanlarda kardiyak komplikasyon riski daha da yükselmektedir.Akut koroner olaylar daha düşük sıklıkta görülmekle birlikte klinik açıdan önemlidir ve özellikle altta yatan koroner arter hastalığı bulunan bireylerde dikkatle değerlendirilmelidir. Sistemik enflamasyon, hipoksemi, artmış sempatik aktivite, miyokardiyal oksijen sunum-talep dengesizliği, endotel disfonksiyonu, prokoagülan aktivite ve kardiyopulmoner hemodinamik etkileşimler bu komplikasyonların gelişiminde rol oynayan başlıca mekanizmalar olarak öne çıkmaktadır.Prefüzyon F proteinini hedefleyen yeni RSV aşılarının kullanıma girmesiyle birlikte erişkin RSV enfeksiyonunun önlenmesinde yeni bir dönem başlamıştır.Randomize kontrollü çalışmalar ve gerçek yaşam verileri, yaşlı erişkinlerde RSV ilişkili alt solunum yolu hastalığı ve hastaneye yatışların önemli ölçüde azaltılabildiğini göstermektedir.Kardiyovasküler hastalığı bulunan bireylerin ağır RSV açısından yüksek risk taşımaları nedeniyle bu hasta grubunda korunma stratejilerinin özellikle önemli olduğu düşünülmektedir.Bununla birlikte aşılama ile miyokard enfarktüsü, akut kalp yetersizliği, aritmi, inme veya kardiyovasküler mortalite gibi spesifik kardiyovasküler sonlanımlar arasındaki ilişkinin daha kapsamlı prospektif çalışmalarla ortaya konmasına ihtiyaç vardır.

Son yıllarda yayımlanan geniş gözlemsel çalışmalar ve sistematik derlemeler, RSV nedeniyle hastaneye yatırılan ileri yaş erişkinlerin yaklaşık beşte birinde akut kardiyak olay görülebileceğini ortaya koymuştur.Bu komplikasyonlar arasında en sık bildirilen kardiyak tablo akut kalp yetersizliğidir.Önceden kalp yetersizliği bulunanlarda kardiyak komplikasyon riski daha da yükselmektedir.Akut koroner olaylar daha düşük sıklıkta görülmekle birlikte klinik açıdan önemlidir ve özellikle altta yatan koroner arter hastalığı bulunan bireylerde dikkatle değerlendirilmelidir. Sistemik enflamasyon, hipoksemi, artmış sempatik aktivite, miyokardiyal oksijen sunum-talep dengesizliği, endotel disfonksiyonu, prokoagülan aktivite ve kardiyopulmoner hemodinamik etkileşimler bu komplikasyonların gelişiminde rol oynayan başlıca mekanizmalar olarak öne çıkmaktadır.Prefüzyon F proteinini hedefleyen yeni RSV aşılarının kullanıma girmesiyle birlikte erişkin RSV enfeksiyonunun önlenmesinde yeni bir dönem başlamıştır.Randomize kontrollü çalışmalar ve gerçek yaşam verileri, yaşlı erişkinlerde RSV ilişkili alt solunum yolu hastalığı ve hastaneye yatışların önemli ölçüde azaltılabildiğini göstermektedir.Kardiyovasküler hastalığı bulunan bireylerin ağır RSV açısından yüksek risk taşımaları nedeniyle bu hasta grubunda korunma stratejilerinin özellikle önemli olduğu düşünülmektedir.Bununla birlikte aşılama ile miyokard enfarktüsü, akut kalp yetersizliği, aritmi, inme veya kardiyovasküler mortalite gibi spesifik kardiyovasküler sonlanımlar arasındaki ilişkinin daha kapsamlı prospektif çalışmalarla ortaya konmasına ihtiyaç vardır.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection is increasingly recognized as a significant cause of morbidity, hospitalization, and mortality in adults, particularly those with pre-existing cardiovascular diseases. The study aimed to explore the relationship between RSV infection and cardiovascular complications in adults.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a comprehensive review of observational studies and systematic analyses published in recent years, focusing on hospitalized adults with RSV infection, especially those with pre-existing cardiovascular conditions.
analysis.methods: The analysis synthesized findings from observational studies and systematic reviews, emphasizing the mechanisms linking RSV infection to cardiovascular complications and the potential impact of vaccination strategies on these outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Recent studies have shown that approximately 20% of hospitalized adults with RSV infection experience acute cardiac events, with acute heart failure being the most frequently reported complication. Individuals with pre-existing heart failure have a significantly increased risk of cardiac complications following RSV infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that RSV infection can trigger acute cardiovascular events, highlighting the need for targeted prevention strategies in high-risk populations. This study provides novel insights into the bidirectional relationship between RSV and cardiovascular diseases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of RSV vaccination in adults with cardiovascular diseases to reduce the risk of severe complications and hospitalizations, offering a basis for future public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on observational studies and systematic reviews, which may be subject to biases and confounding factors. However, the high prevalence of cardiac complications in RSV-infected adults with pre-existing conditions supports a moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the relationship between respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection and cardiovascular complications in adults, highlighting that RSV is a growing cause of morbidity, hospitalization, and mortality in this population. It identifies acute heart failure as the most common cardiac complication, particularly in individuals with pre-existing heart failure. The authors emphasize the bidirectional interaction between RSV and cardiovascular diseases, suggesting that targeted prevention strategies, such as vaccination, are crucial for high-risk groups. While the evidence is based on observational studies and systematic reviews, the moderate confidence in findings is supported by the high prevalence of cardiac events in RSV-infected adults with underlying conditions. The study calls for further research to explore the specific cardiovascular outcomes associated with RSV vaccination.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染正日益被认识到是成人发病率、住院和死亡率的重要原因,特别是那些有既往心血管疾病的患者。本研究旨在探讨RSV感染与成人心血管并发症之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对近年来发表的观察性研究和系统性综述的全面回顾,重点关注因RSV感染住院的成年人,尤其是那些有既往心血管疾病的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 分析综合了观察性研究和系统性综述的结果,强调了RSV感染与心血管并发症之间的机制联系,以及疫苗接种策略对这些结果的潜在影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 近年来的研究表明,约有20%因RSV感染住院的成年人会出现急性心脏事件,其中急性心力衰竭是最常见的并发症。对于既往有心力衰竭的患者,RSV感染后心脏并发症的风险显著增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为RSV感染可能引发急性心血管事件,强调在高风险人群中需要有针对性的预防策略。本研究提供了关于RSV与心血管疾病之间双向关系的新见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突出了对患有心血管疾病的成年人进行RSV疫苗接种的重要性,以降低严重并发症和住院的风险,为未来的公共卫生干预提供了基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些证据基于观察性研究和系统性综述,可能受到偏倚和混杂因素的影响。然而,RSV感染成年人中既往存在疾病的心脏并发症高发生率支持了研究结果的中等可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)传统上被认为是儿童毛细支气管炎和肺炎的重要病因,但如今已被定义为老年人和患有慢性疾病的个体中导致显著发病率、住院和死亡率的重要原因。特别是患有心力衰竭、冠状动脉疾病和其他心血管疾病的成年人,属于严重RSV感染的高风险群体。然而,RSV与心血管系统之间的关系并非单向。既往存在的心血管疾病会增加RSV感染严重发展的可能性,而急性RSV感染也可能引发心力衰竭失代偿、急性冠状动脉综合征、心肌损伤、心房和心室心律失常以及其他急性心脏事件。近年来发表的广泛观察性研究和系统性综述表明,约有20%因RSV感染住院的老年人会出现急性心脏事件。这些并发症中最常见的就是急性心力衰竭。对于既往有心力衰竭的患者,RSV感染后心脏并发症的风险显著增加。尽管急性冠状动脉事件的发生率较低,但临床意义重大,特别是在存在潜在冠状动脉疾病的个体中应特别注意。系统性炎症、低氧血症、交感神经活动增强、心肌供氧与需氧失衡、内皮功能障碍、促凝血活性以及心肺血流动力学相互作用被认为是这些并发症发生的主要机制。随着针对RSV的预融合F蛋白的新疫苗的问世,成人RSV感染的预防进入了一个新的阶段。随机对照试验和真实世界数据表明,在老年人中,RSV相关下呼吸道疾病和住院率可以显著降低。由于心血管疾病患者在严重RSV感染方面具有更高的风险,因此在这一患者群体中实施预防策略尤为重要。然而,仍需要更全面的前瞻性研究来进一步阐明疫苗接种与特定心血管结局(如心肌梗死、急性心力衰竭、心律失常、中风或心血管死亡率)之间的关系。
papers.summary_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)传统上被认为是儿童毛细支气管炎和肺炎的重要病因,但如今已被定义为老年人和患有慢性疾病的个体中导致显著发病率、住院和死亡率的重要原因。特别是患有心力衰竭、冠状动脉疾病和其他心血管疾病的成年人,属于严重RSV感染的高风险群体。然而,RSV与心血管系统之间的关系并非单向。既往存在的心血管疾病会增加RSV感染严重发展的可能性,而急性RSV感染也可能引发心力衰竭失代偿、急性冠状动脉综合征、心肌损伤、心房和心室心律失常以及其他急性心脏事件。近年来发表的广泛观察性研究和系统性综述表明,约有20%因RSV感染住院的老年人会出现急性心脏事件。这些并发症中最常见的就是急性心力衰竭。对于既往有心力衰竭的患者,RSV感染后心脏并发症的风险显著增加。尽管急性冠状动脉事件的发生率较低,但临床意义重大,特别是在存在潜在冠状动脉疾病的个体中应特别注意。系统性炎症、低氧血症、交感神经活动增强、心肌供氧与需氧失衡、内皮功能障碍、促凝血活性以及心肺血流动力学相互作用被认为是这些并发症发生的主要机制。随着针对RSV的预融合F蛋白的新疫苗的问世,成人RSV感染的预防进入了一个新的阶段。随机对照试验和真实世界数据表明,在老年人中,RSV相关下呼吸道疾病和住院率可以显著降低。由于心血管疾病患者在严重RSV感染方面具有更高的风险,因此在这一患者群体中实施预防策略尤为重要。然而,仍需要更全面的前瞻性研究来进一步阐明疫苗接种与特定心血管结局(如心肌梗死、急性心力衰竭、心律失常、中风或心血管死亡率)之间的关系。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染正日益被认识到是成人发病率、住院和死亡率的重要原因,特别是那些有既往心血管疾病的患者。本研究旨在探讨RSV感染与成人心血管并发症之间的关系。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对近年来发表的观察性研究和系统性综述的全面回顾,重点关注因RSV感染住院的成年人,尤其是那些有既往心血管疾病的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 分析综合了观察性研究和系统性综述的结果,强调了RSV感染与心血管并发症之间的机制联系,以及疫苗接种策略对这些结果的潜在影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 近年来的研究表明,约有20%因RSV感染住院的成年人会出现急性心脏事件,其中急性心力衰竭是最常见的并发症。对于既往有心力衰竭的患者,RSV感染后心脏并发症的风险显著增加。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为RSV感染可能引发急性心血管事件,强调在高风险人群中需要有针对性的预防策略。本研究提供了关于RSV与心血管疾病之间双向关系的新见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突出了对患有心血管疾病的成年人进行RSV疫苗接种的重要性,以降低严重并发症和住院的风险,为未来的公共卫生干预提供了基础。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些证据基于观察性研究和系统性综述,可能受到偏倚和混杂因素的影响。然而,RSV感染成年人中既往存在疾病的心脏并发症高发生率支持了研究结果的中等可信度。

papers.title: Morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus versus influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults: an adjusted comparative analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Pneumonia is diagnosed based on clinical symptoms and radiological features. It can be caused by a variety of pathogens including bacterial, mycobacterial, viral, fungal, and other atypical organisms. Most bacterial community-acquired pneumonia is due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, which is normally treated with penicillin and can be risk stratified using the CURB-65 score. Atypical organisms require macrolides. Hospital-acquired pneumonia involves Gram-negative or resistant organisms and treatment depends on local sensitivities. Viral pneumonias can include influenza and COVID-19, with antivirals used only in specific cases. Immunocompromised patients may develop invasive fungal infections such as Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia or invasive aspergillosis requiring targeted antifungals.

papers.title_original: Morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus versus influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults: an adjusted comparative analysis

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections with influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults. The background highlighted the importance of understanding the clinical impact of these viral infections in this vulnerable population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was an adjusted comparative analysis conducted in hospitalized older adults. It focused on respiratory syncytial virus and influenza virus infections, comparing their associated morbidity and mortality outcomes.
analysis.methods: The methods involved analyzing data from hospitalized older adults to compare the clinical outcomes of respiratory syncytial virus and influenza virus infections. The analysis included adjustments for confounding factors to ensure accurate comparison.
analysis.main_results: The study directly observed that respiratory syncytial virus infections were associated with higher morbidity and mortality compared to influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting the greater severity of RSV infections in older adults, which is a novel insight into the differential impact of these viruses on hospitalization outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform targeted surveillance and management strategies for respiratory syncytial virus in older adults, potentially improving clinical outcomes and resource allocation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is limited by its observational nature and potential confounding factors, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults. It highlights the greater clinical impact of RSV, suggesting a need for targeted surveillance and management. The analysis is observational and adjusted for confounding factors, leading to a moderate confidence assessment. The findings may inform public health strategies for older adult populations, emphasizing the importance of distinguishing between these viral infections in clinical settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染与流感病毒感染在住院老年人中的发病率和死亡率。背景强调了了解这些病毒感染在这一易感人群中的临床影响的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项调整后的比较分析,针对住院老年人进行,重点比较了呼吸道合胞病毒和流感病毒感染的发病率和死亡率结果。
elements_zh.methods: 研究方法涉及分析住院老年人的数据,以比较呼吸道合胞病毒和流感病毒感染的临床结果。分析过程中对混杂因素进行了调整,以确保比较的准确性。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究直接观察到,呼吸道合胞病毒感染与流感病毒感染相比,在住院老年人中与更高的发病率和死亡率相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调呼吸道合胞病毒感染在老年人中的严重性,这是对这些病毒在住院结果上不同影响的新见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对呼吸道合胞病毒感染的老年人的预防和管理策略提供信息,可能有助于改善临床结果和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究的观察性质以及潜在的混杂因素,研究证据存在一定的局限性,导致中等程度的置信度评估。

papers.title: Epidemiology and lagged climatic drivers of pediatric viral lower respiratory tract infections in Tianjin, China (2023–2025)
papers.abstract: Background Following the lifting of pandemic-era restrictions, China experienced a sharp resurgence in pediatric respiratory infections; however, post-pandemic epidemiological and climatic data on lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) from the temperate continental climate of northern China remain scarce. Methods In this retrospective, single-center surveillance study, we characterized the post-pandemic epidemiology of six respiratory viruses in children hospitalized with LRTI in Tianjin and assessed their pathogen-specific, lagged climatic associations. Children aged 0–18 years hospitalized between January 2023 and December 2025 were tested by targeted next-generation sequencing for human rhinovirus (HRV), adenovirus (ADV), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), human bocavirus (HBoV), influenza virus (IFV), and human metapneumovirus (HMPV). Pathogen–climate associations were estimated using a quasi-Poisson model that adjusted for seasonality, secular trend, and lagged meteorological exposures. Results Among 2,597 virus-positive cases, the leading pathogens were HRV (30.7%), ADV (26.6%), and RSV (20.6%), followed by HBoV (12.1%), IFV (6.0%), and HMPV (4.0%). Age distributions differed by pathogen (p<0.05): RSV and HBoV predominated in infants and toddlers, HRV and HMPV in preschoolers, ADV in school-aged children, and IFV across the older preschool-to-school-age range; males predominated for all viruses except IFV. Five viruses peaked in December, whereas HBoV peaked uniquely in July. After adjustment for seasonality and secular trend, the unadjusted associations of IFV with humidity and temperature disappeared, indicating that they largely reflected shared seasonality. In contrast, RSV retained associations with temperature (RR 3.87, 95% CI 1.39–10.76) and wind speed (RR 5.46, 95% CI 2.39–12.47) at a 1-month lag, and HMPV with temperature (RR 13.3, 95% CI 1.64–108.3; imprecise given its low case count); HRV, ADV, and HBoV showed no independent climatic associations. Co-infections occurred in 116 cases (4.5%), most frequently HBoV+HRV (23.3%). Conclusion Post-pandemic pediatric viral LRTI in Tianjin shows distinctive pathogen-specific profiles in age, seasonality, and climatic sensitivity. The summer peak of HBoV and the seasonally independent climatic drivers of RSV and HMPV provide a preliminary basis that, if confirmed with higher-resolution data, could inform pathogen-tailored, climate-informed surveillance in northern Chinese megacities.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the post-pandemic epidemiology and climatic drivers of pediatric viral lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) in Tianjin, China, focusing on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The research highlights the distinct age-specific and seasonal patterns of RSV, with a notable predominance in infants and toddlers. The study employed a retrospective, single-center surveillance approach using targeted next-generation sequencing to identify viral pathogens and assess their associations with climatic factors. Key findings include RSV's unique climatic associations with temperature and wind speed at a 1-month lag, which suggest potential for climate-informed surveillance strategies. However, the study acknowledges limitations, such as the influence of shared seasonality on some results, and emphasizes the need for higher-resolution data to confirm these findings. The results contribute to understanding the dynamics of RSV in northern China and may inform targeted public health interventions.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 不同病原体的年龄分布存在差异(p<0.05):RSV和HBoV在婴儿和幼儿中占主导地位,HRV和HMPV在学龄前儿童中占主导地位,ADV在学龄儿童中占主导地位,IFV则在较大的学龄前至学龄儿童中占主导地位;所有病毒中,男性均占主导地位,除了IFV。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HBoV在夏季的高峰以及RSV和HMPV与季节性无关的气候驱动因素为未来在北方中国大城市的病原体特异性、气候相关监测提供了初步依据,如果能通过更高分辨率的数据加以验证,将有助于制定针对性的防控策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 在调整了季节性和长期趋势后,IFV与湿度和温度的未调整关联消失,表明这些关联主要反映了共同的季节性。

papers.title_zh: 流行病学和滞后气候驱动因素对中国天津市儿童病毒性下呼吸道感染(2023–2025)的影响
papers.source_body_en: Background Following the lifting of pandemic-era restrictions, China experienced a sharp resurgence in pediatric respiratory infections; however, post-pandemic epidemiological and climatic data on lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) from the temperate continental climate of northern China remain scarce. Methods In this retrospective, single-center surveillance study, we characterized the post-pandemic epidemiology of six respiratory viruses in children hospitalized with LRTI in Tianjin and assessed their pathogen-specific, lagged climatic associations. Children aged 0–18 years hospitalized between January 2023 and December 2025 were tested by targeted next-generation sequencing for human rhinovirus (HRV), adenovirus (ADV), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), human bocavirus (HBoV), influenza virus (IFV), and human metapneumovirus (HMPV). Pathogen–climate associations were estimated using a quasi-Poisson model that adjusted for seasonality, secular trend, and lagged meteorological exposures. Results Among 2,597 virus-positive cases, the leading pathogens were HRV (30.7%), ADV (26.6%), and RSV (20.6%), followed by HBoV (12.1%), IFV (6.0%), and HMPV (4.0%). Age distributions differed by pathogen (p<0.05): RSV and HBoV predominated in infants and toddlers, HRV and HMPV in preschoolers, ADV in school-aged children, and IFV across the older preschool-to-school-age range; males predominated for all viruses except IFV. Five viruses peaked in December, whereas HBoV peaked uniquely in July. After adjustment for seasonality and secular trend, the unadjusted associations of IFV with humidity and temperature disappeared, indicating that they largely reflected shared seasonality. In contrast, RSV retained associations with temperature (RR 3.87, 95% CI 1.39–10.76) and wind speed (RR 5.46, 95% CI 2.39–12.47) at a 1-month lag, and HMPV with temperature (RR 13.3, 95% CI 1.64–108.3; imprecise given its low case count); HRV, ADV, and HBoV showed no independent climatic associations. Co-infections occurred in 116 cases (4.5%), most frequently HBoV+HRV (23.3%). Conclusion Post-pandemic pediatric viral LRTI in Tianjin shows distinctive pathogen-specific profiles in age, seasonality, and climatic sensitivity. The summer peak of HBoV and the seasonally independent climatic drivers of RSV and HMPV provide a preliminary basis that, if confirmed with higher-resolution data, could inform pathogen-tailored, climate-informed surveillance in northern Chinese megacities.

Vaquera-Aparicio , Servicio de Infectología, Hospital Universitario Dr. José Eleuterio González, Monterrey, N.L., México Mariana Merlo-Palomera, Servicio de Infectología, Antiguo Hospital Civil de Guadalajara, Jal., México Leticia Belmont-Martínez, Laboratorio de Errores Innatos del Metabolismo y Tamiz, Instituto Nacional de Pediatría, Ciudad de México, México Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the leading causes of acute lower respiratory tract infection, bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and hospitalization among infants and young children, with the highest risk of severe disease observed in infants younger than six months, preterm infants, and children with bronchopulmonary dysplasia, congenital heart disease, immunocompromising conditions, and other underlying comorbidities. In Mexico, available evidence demonstrates a substantial clinical burden and a predominant seasonal circulation from September to March. In recent years, the development of novel preventive strategies has transformed the approach to RSV prevention, particularly through maternal immunization with a bivalent prefusion F protein vaccine and passive immunoprophylaxis with long-acting monoclonal antibodies. This position statement from the Mexican Academy of Pediatrics reviews the epidemiological, clinical, and real-world effectiveness evidence regarding currently available strategies for the prevention of RSV infection in the pediatric population. Maternal vaccination between 32 and 36 weeks of gestation promotes transplacental antibody transfer and provides protection to infants during the first months of life. Monoclonal antibodies, particularly nirsevimab, have demonstrated significant reductions in lower respiratory tract infection, hospitalization, intensive care unit admission, and severe RSV-associated disease, with a favorable safety profile. Based on disease burden, national seasonality, availability of preventive products, and the characteristics of the Mexican health care system, the Mexican Academy of Pediatrics proposes a complementary and progressive strategy integrating maternal vaccination and monoclonal antibody immunoprophylaxis, initially prioritizing high-risk infants and gradually expanding coverage to all susceptible infants. Implementation should consider efficacy, safety, cost-effectiveness, operational feasibility, equity, and timely access. Keywords: Respiratory syncytial virus. Maternal vaccination. Monoclonal antibodies. Recommendations. Prevention. Infants.

analysis.summary_en: This position statement from the Mexican Academy of Pediatrics addresses the need for effective strategies to prevent respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection in the pediatric population, emphasizing the significant clinical burden and seasonal circulation of RSV in Mexico. The study reviews the epidemiological, clinical, and real-world effectiveness of current preventive measures, including maternal immunization with a bivalent prefusion F protein vaccine and passive immunoprophylaxis with monoclonal antibodies like nirsevimab. The findings indicate that monoclonal antibodies have shown substantial reductions in RSV-related hospitalizations and severe disease with a favorable safety profile. The authors interpret these results as a transformative shift in RSV prevention, advocating for a complementary and progressive strategy that prioritizes high-risk infants and expands coverage to all susceptible infants. The proposed strategy considers factors such as efficacy, safety, cost-effectiveness, and equitable access. The evidence is strong and grounded in the Mexican health care system's context, but the implementation requires careful evaluation of these factors to ensure operational feasibility and public health impact.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是导致婴幼儿和年幼儿童急性下呼吸道感染、毛细支气管炎、肺炎和住院的主要原因之一,其中6个月以下婴儿、早产儿以及患有支气管肺发育不良、先天性心脏病、免疫抑制状况及其他基础合并症的儿童面临最严重的疾病风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本立场声明由墨西哥儿科学会发布,回顾了目前可用于预防RSV感染的策略在流行病学、临床及实际应用效果方面的证据。
elements_zh.methods: 孕妇在妊娠32至36周期间接受呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)免疫,可促进胎盘抗体转移,从而在婴儿出生后的最初几个月内提供保护。
elements_zh.main_results: 单克隆抗体,特别是尼塞韦单抗(尼塞韦单抗),已被证明可显著降低下呼吸道感染、住院、重症监护病房入院以及严重RSV相关疾病的发病率,且具有良好的安全性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 近年来,新型预防策略的发展改变了RSV预防的应对方式,特别是在通过双价前融合F蛋白呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疫苗进行母体免疫以及使用长效单克隆抗体进行被动免疫预防方面。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 基于疾病负担、国家季节性、预防产品的可获得性以及墨西哥医疗体系的特征,墨西哥儿科学会提出了一项互补且逐步推进的策略,整合母体呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)免疫和单克隆抗体免疫预防,初期优先考虑高风险婴儿,随后逐步扩大覆盖范围至所有易感婴儿。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 实施过程中应考虑有效性、安全性、成本效益、操作可行性、公平性以及及时获得性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是导致婴幼儿和年幼儿童急性下呼吸道感染、毛细支气管炎、肺炎和住院的主要原因之一,其中6个月以下婴儿、早产儿以及患有支气管肺发育不良、先天性心脏病、免疫抑制状况及其他基础合并症的儿童面临最严重的疾病风险。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本立场声明由墨西哥儿科学会发布,回顾了目前可用于预防RSV感染的策略在流行病学、临床及实际应用效果方面的证据。
analysis_zh.methods: 孕妇在妊娠32至36周期间接受呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)免疫,可促进胎盘抗体转移,从而在婴儿出生后的最初几个月内提供保护。
analysis_zh.main_results: 单克隆抗体,特别是尼塞韦单抗(尼塞韦单抗),已被证明可显著降低下呼吸道感染、住院、重症监护病房入院以及严重RSV相关疾病的发病率,且具有良好的安全性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 近年来,新型预防策略的发展改变了RSV预防的应对方式,特别是在通过双价前融合F蛋白呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疫苗进行母体免疫以及使用长效单克隆抗体进行被动免疫预防方面。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 基于疾病负担、国家季节性、预防产品的可获得性以及墨西哥医疗体系的特征,墨西哥儿科学会提出了一项互补且逐步推进的策略,整合母体呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)免疫和单克隆抗体免疫预防,初期优先考虑高风险婴儿,随后逐步扩大覆盖范围至所有易感婴儿。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 实施过程中应考虑有效性、安全性、成本效益、操作可行性、公平性以及及时获得性。
